'''Paul Todd Feldman Hiding In The Clouds''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Paul Todd Feldman]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/Hiding.html Paul Todd Feldman's Hiding in the Clouds!], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991104021342/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/Hiding.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah (location)|Dagobah-L-dagobah.gif|label=Dagobah}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dagobah and Clouds
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Feldman LS Hiding Clouds Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
A [[Dagobah (location)|Dagobah]] deck with three [[Yoda]]s, three [[Son Of Skywalker]]s and six [[Clouds]].<ref name="torch" />
